scope: Allow authorized supervisors to reschedule one pending task occurrence with an audit reason and notification.
finding: Jefatura could adjust task weights and managers could assign/comment, but there was no punctual rescheduling action. Changes to scheduledOn were also absent from the notification comparison.
changes: Jefatura and an active encargado with direct team and company scope can reschedule an individual pending task with no start, timer, activity, or closed company period.
The date must be valid and within the task accounting month; a 5-500 character reason is required.
Only scheduledOn changes. The task deadline, accounting month, and recurring assignment remain unchanged.
The application audit records actor, date, and reason; authorized recipients receive a task-changed notice.
The task detail exposes a compact form only to authorized supervisors. Joint, started, active, or closed work cannot be changed through this action.
